description: Free English class offered for Massachusetts residents who are native speakers of languages such as Spanish, Haitian Creole, Arabic, Albanian, Somali and more.
whatThisIs: ABCD is an organization that wants to better aid parents to help their children in school,  find employment, and have easier communication with medical care.
relatedLinkExplanation: To learn more about Action for Boston Community Development (ABCD)
whoItHelps: Non Native English Speakers struggling to learn English on their own. The Location of these classes are primarily held in the Boston Area (Roxbury, Mattapan, and Roxbury) but you do not need to be a resident of these neighborhoods to apply.
whatItHelps: Learning English , Learn Computer Skills, Health Literacy
whatToKnow: You need to be a Massachusetts resident to apply, and be able to attend classes in (Roxbury, Mattapan, and Roxbury).
name: English for Speakers of Other Languages (ESOL)
